details: JSON request/response over WebSocket at 127.0.0.1:9399; real-time events; api.schema publishes methods, models, parameters and access levels. Source registers 130 literal methods plus 10 Voice helper schema methods (140 unique names).
caveat: 140 is a count of current source registrations, not a live installed-app measurement; aliases are included. Older docs say 35+ or about 120.

capability: TypeScript SDK and persistent project twin
details: Package exports daemon client, assistant planner, CUA SDK and project-twin surface; ProjectTwin supports a persistent Pi process with invocation context, protocol, memory, events, model and effort options, plus optional OpenScout relay context.
caveat: Daemon client is implemented; ProjectTwin requires the external Pi runtime. Do not present a project twin as an always-running native app service.

details: Read windows and desktop snapshot, search indexed/live sources, list tmux sessions and inventory, projects, Spaces, layers, processes and process trees; synthesize terminal identities and capture exact terminal text; read OCR snapshots, search, history and recent scans.
caveat: AX/OCR and terminal capture are distinct sources. This audit did not run scans or inspect live client data.

capability: Target resolution, action receipts and undo
details: Resolve window targets, execute typed actions with dry-run planning, inspect action history and undo recorded placements or batches. Receipts explain targets, plans, verification and trace.
caveat: Undo is available for eligible recorded placement operations; it is not a general reversal of all computer-use input.

details: Create/list/read runs and artifacts; save window, region or display screenshots; zoom an existing artifact.
caveat: Screen capture requires macOS permission. Artifacts are run evidence; generation is not visual review.

details: Record a window or region to a movie and stop recording; CLI can record a target while executing an action command.
caveat: A start acknowledgement is not completed video verification. Lattices capture overlaps with the separate Action product.

details: Snapshot a target window as AX, screenshot or both; expose element IDs and tree metadata; press, show menu, focus, type into an element, and set its value.
caveat: Element references are snapshot-local. Background-safe operations depend on the requested AX action and target app.

details: Target a window, session or app; send keys/hotkeys, click/double-click/right-click, scroll or drag, then request verification. Operations expose stage, present and execute treatments.
caveat: Availability depends on macOS permissions and target behavior; default staging is not proof that a mutation executed.

details: Prepare a terminal target, focus a verified window, launch a Mac app, type into ordinary app windows or safe terminal targets, and run terminal/Scout demonstration helpers.
caveat: Demo helpers are specialist execution workflows, not general workspace navigation.

details: Show a recorded cursor or magic cursor with app-owned appearance, motion and captions; configure cursor appearance; find or summon the real mouse.
caveat: Synthetic presentation and real pointer input are separate operations.

capability: Local image text analysis and native browser reads
details: Analyze a captured window or saved image with local Vision OCR; extract text and evaluate contains/not-contains expectations. Native browser RPC exposes text, DOM query and JavaScript methods.
caveat: Native image analysis is local text recognition and explicit checks, not provider-backed semantic image understanding. Native browser RPC is distinct from browser MCP and depends on browser support.

details: Publish and clear screen-local toasts, labels, highlights and pet layers, with target display, lifetime, style, opacity and ordering.
caveat: These are overlay canvas layers, separate from persistent workspace layers.

capability: Persistent actors and project web HUDs
details: Publish clickable app/sprite actors, animate them, attach URL/HTML hover HUDs and toggle the actor layer; CLI registers, discovers, publishes and synchronizes project HUD manifests.
caveat: Actor renderer currently supports sprites. A hover web HUD is not a native app integration by itself.

details: lats mcp serves stdio JSON-RPC with lazy toolset selection and harness config output. Current registry contains one toolset, browser, with 14 tools.
caveat: Do not label the whole native daemon API as available through MCP. Native workspace methods currently use CLI/daemon/SDK.

details: List, select and inspect named Action-owned Chrome profiles; unknown identity names create a blank profile on first open; report optional companion extension health.
caveat: These are separate browser identities, not the user's regular Chrome profiles.

details: Import selected cookies from a chosen regular Chrome profile into an isolated browser identity with a domain allowlist and dry-run default.
caveat: Writing cookies requires explicit confirmation within the tool contract and appropriate authorization; no blanket signed-in assumption.

details: Open URLs in the controlled isolated Chrome or hand a URL to regular Chrome; list/open tabs and enforce a navigation readiness deadline.
caveat: Regular Chrome mode is an open-only handoff, not DOM-controlled access to everyday browser tabs.

details: Read page metadata, visible text and selectors for interactive elements; inspect console calls, uncaught errors, promise rejections and Chrome resource/CSP logs.
caveat: Complete console coverage applies to tabs opened through browser_open; tool responses report coverage.

details: Click by CSS selector or visible text, fill form/contenteditable controls and wait for paint, navigation, network idle, selector appearance or disappearance.
caveat: These actions operate only on the active isolated browser identity.

details: Set exact per-tab emulated viewport or resize the hosting window; choose device pixel ratio, mobile emulation and media-query assertions; reset overrides.
caveat: Per-tab overrides are reversible and session-local; physical window size can be clamped by the display.

details: Capture PNGs of viewport, one selected element, an explicit document rectangle, or the full page; save locally and optionally return pixels.
caveat: Full-page capture has a Chrome maximum-edge limit and reports truncation.

details: Close an owned tab or release the session browser; browser quits only once no other live session claims it. MCP toolsets own initialization and idle bookkeeping.
caveat: No lifecycle call closes the user's regular Chrome.

details: The menu bar process hosts Hudson Voice/Vox live transcription at port 9398; command window uses push-to-talk; transcript routes to local intent matching and optional provider interpretation.
caveat: Requires a voice-enabled build (HUDSONKIT_WITH_VOICE), permissions and configured engines. Input is app-owned and stops with Lattices; synthesis uses the separate Voice helper.

details: List and execute intents, simulate spoken text, preview the TypeScript assistant plan, and invoke hands-off command interpretation. Voice targets the same window/layer/optimization executor as scripted actions.
caveat: Provider-backed interpretations require a configured runtime or credentials; local command coverage is broader evidence than any specific natural-language example.

details: Workspace chat first uses local agent-runtime/ACP harness, then a saved HudsonAI provider key, then a Scout project session. Picker supports Claude Code, Codex, Pi and OpenCode; model choices are supported for Claude/Codex/Pi and reasoning effort for Codex.
caveat: Current source contradicts older Scout-only assistant documentation. Each route requires its corresponding installed/authenticated service; OpenCode adapter currently ignores model selection.

details: Lattices forwards voice.say/stop/pause/resume/skip/seek/list/select/lease/release to separately installed Voice. The helper owns synthesis, queue, playback, HUD, preferences and authenticated RPC; leases prevent overlapping agents.
caveat: Requires installed and running Voice plus capability authorization. The reply to say means queued, not playback completed. Legacy internal identifiers remain speech.*.

capability: System, cloud and local synthesis providers
details: Voice catalog includes macOS system voices, OpenAI, ElevenLabs and Kokoro; provider voice availability is queried rather than invented; Kokoro uses an in-process Neural Engine runtime.
caveat: Cloud providers need credentials; Kokoro needs compiled support and a ready model. Source support was inspected, no live synthesis was run.

details: Lattices Apps catalog presents Blink, Action and Voice as separate standalone products, with Install when missing and Open when installed. lats action provides status, install, launch and raw agent calls.
caveat: They have independent app lifecycles and releases. Catalog registration does not establish current downloaded artifact availability.

details: Mac host publishes manifest, snapshot and perform contract; deck controls voice, app/window switching, layer activation, optimize, frontmost placement/resize, focus, undo and optional Talkie actions.
caveat: Talkie controls depend on Talkie. Deck is a thin control surface over Mac execution, not a second desktop engine.

details: Bonjour discovery on port 5287, explicit Mac approval, per-device agreement, signed timestamp/nonce requests, encrypted payloads and per-route capability grants.
caveat: Bridge is disabled by default. Source presence does not prove App Store distribution or connectivity to any particular device.

capability: iPhone/iPad host roster and fleet controls
details: Lattices Deck has a Home roster, one-Mac host view and multi-host fleet destination; tracks reachable/trusted machines, attention and activity, with per-host voice selection.
caveat: Do not infer a cloud relay service from the Home cloud status UI; this is current iOS source, not a device validation.

capability: Trackpad, key chords and clipboard transfer
details: Send trackpad events, key chords and phone text to the paired Mac; switch Spaces and focus displays; find/summon mouse. Phone paste restores the Mac clipboard.
caveat: Control is scoped by pairing capabilities; synthesized Space hotkeys route through Mac space switching.

details: Display a paired Mac screenshot, select a display, manually refresh or auto-refresh one JPEG at a time, pausing/resuming updates.
caveat: This is a read-only preview with a two-second refresh interval, not a high-frame-rate remote desktop stream.

details: Start, stop, cancel and prewarm voice on the selected Mac, with phase, transcript and error state reflected back in deck snapshots.
caveat: The iPad does not capture microphone audio; voice commands use the selected Mac microphone.

capability: Native automation, capture and artifact review
details: Separate signed Action.app with its own local agent, permissions, WebKit, screenshot and ScreenCaptureKit recording, guided capture, replay/review, session traces, AX/OCR observations, target resolution and deterministic act.execute.
caveat: Implemented action kinds are click, type, press-key, drag, scroll, focus-window and open-app. Recording completion requires finished marker/status. Full trace-to-scenario generation and production composition remain roadmap.

capability: Supervised drive leases and presentation stage
details: Name the automation driver/task, begin/release/status a drive lease, publish short status notes, aim a synthetic cursor, play note/aim/wait/act beats, and set/clear/status a scene drape.
caveat: Background drive is supported; attention approval is explicitly not available yet. This source includes ongoing dirty supervision/coordinate work and has not been live-verified in this audit.

capability: Spatial Markdown notes with agent file interface
details: One floating panel per note; capture, place, recall, edit/read, shade and restore geometry. Markdown with frontmatter is durable truth; CLI list/cat/new/present/type/write/search/log, named brandable workspaces, and desk open/move/focus/close/screens all converge through NoteStore.
caveat: Blink owns note/panel lifecycle independently. Proposed agent HTTP/API documents and proposed live-plane collision/scene behavior are not implemented claims.

details: iPhone/iPad receives complete note snapshots over encrypted LAN with explicit Mac approval, offline cache, identity binding and revocable device trust.
caveat: Read-only; LAN is the implemented route. Tailscale/hosted-relay paths are future providers, not fallback capabilities.

details: CLI detects project type, starts dev command, builds, restarts, reports logs and daemon health, updates CLI/app, launches/quits/rebuilds native app; root scripts expose type checks, app build, CLI/e2e tests and product-family checks.
caveat: Source toolchain capability, not confirmation that all builds/tests pass or releases are current.

details: Repository contains product skills for lattices, action, voice and blink; agent docs provide method discovery, exact terminal capture, canonical action/placement contracts, dry runs, receipts and docs artifacts.
caveat: Some docs retain stale lats/speech skill labels, obsolete standalone Action Browser plugin wording, or describe the speaking helper as embedded. Current source, product AGENTS contracts and MCP registry are authoritative.
